measured_revision_note: Measured before the batch correction and suite expansion; revision names HEAD with uncommitted runner changes. bf05908 contains those runner changes.

tokens.method: Sum per-step OpenCode normalized counters; append verified final completion only when absent from step_finish. Assert unique step IDs and equality to persisted reported_usage. Primary cohort contains both graded variants for the same case and repeat. Failed tests remain included; execution failures are excluded symmetrically.

definitions.input: Reported input counter, separate from cached input
definitions.output: Reported output counter, separate from reasoning
definitions.cache_read: Reported cached input read counter; repeated contexts are counted for each request
definitions.all_categories: input + cache_read + cache_write + output + reasoning; token volume, not a currency charge
definitions.usage_records: Per-step usage records plus the final completion when needed; not tool-call count

limitations: Provider/OpenCode-reported counters; not independently audited billing.
Interrupted or provider-error attempts have partial usage; all-run observed totals are a lower bound.
Three repeats across twelve scenarios do not establish a stable general reduction.
The with-skill measurements include skill loading overhead.
